title: Blessed Assurance
lyrics_original: Oh, what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior all the day long.
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.        || This is my story ||
Perfect submission, all is at rest,
I in my Savior am happy and blest;
Filled with His goodness lost in His love.      || This is my story ||

bible_verses.telugu: మనస్సాక్షికి కల్మషము తోచకుండునట్లు ప్రోక్షింపబడిన హృదయములు గలవారమును, నిర్మలమైన ఉదకముతో స్నానముచేసిన శరీరములు గలవారమునై యుండి, విశ్వాసవిషయములో సంపూర్ణ నిశ్చయత కలిగి, యథార్థమైన హృదయముతో మనము దేవుని సన్ని ధానమునకు చేరుదము.
bible_verses.english: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.

bible_verses.telugu: మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమని ఆత్మ తానే మన ఆత్మతో కూడ సాక్ష్యమిచ్చుచున్నాడు. మనము పిల్లలమైతే వారసులము, అనగా దేవుని వారసులము; క్రీస్తుతో కూడ మహిమపొందుటకు ఆయనతో శ్రమపడిన యెడల, క్రీస్తుతోడి వారసులము.
bible_verses.english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children. Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

bible_verses.telugu: పితృపారంపర్యమైన మీ వ్యర్థప్రవర్తనను విడిచిపెట్టునట్లుగా వెండి బంగారములవంటి క్షయ వస్తువులచేత మీరు విమోచింపబడలేదుగాని అమూల్యమైన రక్తముచేత, అనగా నిర్దోషమును నిష్కళంకమునగు గొఱ్ఱపిల్లవంటి క్రీస్తు రక్తముచేత, విమోచింపబడితిరని మీరెరుగుదురు గదా
bible_verses.english: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the deep, unshakable assurance that I belong to You. You have washed me in Your love and welcomed me into Your family as an heir of salvation. Teach me to rest completely in Your grace and surrender my heart to Your perfect will. May my life today be a song of joy and praise that reflects Your goodness to everyone around me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the deep, unshakable assurance that I belong to You. You have washed me in Your love and welcomed me into Your family as an heir of salvation. Teach me to rest completely in Your grace and surrender my heart to Your perfect will. May my life today be a song of joy and praise that reflects Your goodness to everyone around me. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Fanny Crosby's classic hymn reminds us that our security is firmly rooted in Jesus, offering us a beautiful glimpse of heavenly glory today. As children of God, redeemed by His grace, we are invited to live out our faith not in fear, but in joyful confidence. When we surrender our hearts to Him, our daily lives become an ongoing song of praise to our Savior. Let this assurance fill your heart today as you celebrate the unending love of Christ.
